India and China Agree to Advance Border Delimitation Talks

India and China have agreed to advance discussions on the delimitation of their boundary, aiming for an early and substantial harvest. The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) stated that an Expert Group will be formed to facilitate these talks. Both nations also agreed to prevent miscalculations along the Line of Actual Control (LAC).
